upcoming.name: 30th Celebration — Wave 2 (Booster Bundle, Mini Tins, Binder)
upcoming.note: Booster Bundle and Mini Tins confirmed Oct 2. Binder Collection date CONTESTED: US product showcase says Oct 2, UK showcase says Sept 16, US Binder detail page says Dec 4. One secondary source states the Binder was originally Oct 2 and has been delayed to Dec 4. HouseOfCarts and this radar leave the Binder date unresolved. Human verify against a single authoritative first-party page before promoting Binder specifically. Mewtwo 'What's Your Favorite?' promo card also distributes Oct 2 via $15 in-store purchase at select retailers (while supplies last). Sources: HouseOfCarts (updated Aug 24, 2026), Pokennoisseur, HouseOfCarts calendar (Sept 19 check), TrackaLacker (Sept 16 check), Joseph Writer Anderson.

upcoming.name: Deck Crafter's Collection
upcoming.note: $9.99 MSRP. Contains: 1 foil Meowth ex promo, 39 tournament-ready Trainer cards (including Boss's Orders, Lillie's Determination, Poké Pad, Ultra Ball as 4-ofs), 1 Pitch Black booster pack, 9 labeled dividers, a Deck Crafter's Guide, 1 Pokémon TCG Live code card. New product type — described as a slimmed-down Trainer's Toolkit successor. Not a ready-to-play deck. Sources: PokeBeach (Aug 6, 2026), PokeGuardian, PocketMonsters.net, Bulbapedia, ICv2.

upcoming.name: 30th Celebration — Espeon ex & Umbreon ex Battle Decks
upcoming.note: Oct 30 confirmed by Galactic Toys, Jetpack Comics, HouseOfCarts, TCGRadar. Level 2 Battle Decks for casual play. Include mythical Pokémon promos featuring Zeraora and Victini. Game3.ca lists 'Oct 10' — appears to be a Canadian editorial discrepancy, not a primary-source date change. Do not act without TPC/pokemon.com confirmation of any alternate date. Sources: multiple retailer listings, Joseph Writer Anderson.

upcoming.name: Delta Reign (ME06, Mega Rayquaza ex — EN of JP Storm Emeralda)
upcoming.note: Fully revealed Aug 20, 2026 via pokemon.com. 103-card main set + 37 secret rares per secondary sources (135+ total). Mega Rayquaza ex, Mega Golurk ex, Mega Malamar ex, Mega Golisopod ex confirmed. Six Stadium cards pair into three Legendary Stadiums (Legendary Ocean Trench, Legendary Summit, Legendary Lava Lake). ETB promo: Kyogre IR confirmed by PokeBeach and TrackaLacker. Prereleases Oct 24–Nov 1; TCG Live launch Nov 5; retail Nov 6. PokémonCenter.com preorder NOT YET OPEN as of Sept 21 — PokeBeach predicted September window based on prior set cadence; GameStop preorders open, Best Buy prices posted. Set code ME06 used by retailers but not confirmed by TPC. Sources: pokemon.com, PokeBeach, HouseOfCarts, ScreenRant, TrackaLacker, EvolVault.

upcoming.name: 30th Celebration — Day & Night UPCs, Ditto Premium, Mewtwo & Mew Figure
upcoming.note: Day UPC (Espeon) / Night UPC (Umbreon) at $179.99 MSRP each — highest standard UPC MSRP to date. Each UPC includes 29 regular 30th Celebration packs plus one three-card Classic Collection pack (not 30 equivalent boosters). Ditto Premium Collection includes 8 booster packs. Sources: Bill's Archive, HouseOfCarts, TrackaLacker.

upcoming.name: JP: Aura Seeker (Mega Lucario Z ex)
upcoming.note: Standard booster expansion (NOT a High Class Pack). Features Mega Lucario Z ex, the first Z Mega Evolution in the TCG. Trademark (Hadou Seeker) filed March 10, 2026 by Nintendo/Creatures/Game Freak. Confirmed by PokeBeach (May 25, 2026) and Bill's Archive — two independent primary sources. No EN announcement yet; EN expected early 2027. Sources: PokeBeach, Bill's Archive, Wargamer, Samurai Sword Tokyo.
